title: Tseitin clause chain
statement: Given a finite list of literals and a finite list of auxiliary literals, process the first four literals whenever at least four remain and an auxiliary literal is available. Output the clause consisting of the first two literals and that auxiliary literal, then continue with the negation of the auxiliary literal followed by the third and fourth original literals and the remaining literals, using the remaining auxiliaries. When fewer than four literals remain or no auxiliary is available, output the remaining literal list as a single clause.
hypotheses_covered: An input list of literals of dimension $n$.
An input list of auxiliary literals of dimension $n$.
